notes: Control-aware client-level DP with the same replacement adjacency and delta as 8C/8D. Family-specific diagonal weights are frozen public quantities derived before private evaluation: fourth roots of central finite-difference curvatures (h=0.1 in normalized log coordinates) of mean nonlinear yaw-tracking RMSE over the three declared public design maneuvers at the public family-center plants, normalized to unit geometric mean. In y=diag(w)z coordinates, contributions are enclosed by C=||w||2, clipped, and released with isotropic analytic-Gaussian noise; mapping back gives shaped noise and preserves DP. Isotropic and shaped methods use common random numbers. Gates: at least one finite cell has >=15% paired tracking improvement over isotropic, <=10% degradation from the common non-private mean, full amplitude feasibility, and frozen rho below one.
